parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty `members` array and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_field_count`, `shared_ancestor`) are null. Without any member-level or field-level evidence it is impossible to determine which members of `AudioPlayerProtocol` are a subset of `TimeShiftablePlayer` (or vice-versa), or whether a protocol-inheritance relationship is genuinely warranted. Recommending a refactor without grounded evidence would risk introducing an incorrect abstraction boundary between two protocols that may be intentionally orthogonal in the `Playback` package.
